title: Lena and the Summer
author: Vesper Nakamura
blurb: Juniper Sterling, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
